defect: Ordinary assurance:update accepted a semantic compiler-configuration change (tsconfig target ES2018 to ES2020) without requiring the explicit source/model review acknowledgement path.
impact: Compiler/toolchain configuration materially controls the compiled implementation used by executable refinement. A normal manifest refresh could therefore acknowledge semantic build drift without the review fence required for source/model changes.
fix: Bind all tracked tsconfig files plus package.json and package-lock.json as the semantic compiler/toolchain environment and make ordinary --write fail when that environment changes unless --ack-source-model-review is explicitly supplied after review.
mutationKill: The assurance-infrastructure mutation guard changes tsconfig.json target and requires ordinary manifest --write to fail specifically with the compiler/toolchain review-fence error.
